messages:
Alice Chen: quick update 1: we need to move the EU maintenance originally planned for 2026-05-10 01:00-02:00 UTC to a slightly later window: 2026-05-10 02:30-04:00 UTC. reason: active pager in eu-west1 with host flapping during preflight checks.

Diego R.: what pager triggered? transient or ongoing?

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered in eu-west1 serving cluster 'svc-a'. Condition: 5xx > 1% for 3m. Alert ID INC-2026-417. Notifying @oncall and @infra-sre.

Priya Patel: saw the alert. it's correlated with a noisy VM pool that started restarting containers. could be kernel or kube agent churn.

Maya Singh: oncall here, taking lead. spinning up deeper host metrics dashboard and looking at container restarts.

infra-sre: host group eu-west1-pool-9 showing repeated docker daemon restarts. isolating affected hosts and shifting traffic. will post isolation commands in a sec.

Alice Chen: thanks; given this, postponing to 02:30 gives SRE time to stabilize hosts and lets us run a conservative canary during the maintenance. need to put together: statuspage blurb, console banner, customer email for paid accounts, and internal oncall runbook update.

Jesse B.: drafting status page now. suggested short entry: 

```
Status: Scheduled Maintenance (Timing Updated)
Start: 2026-05-10 02:30 UTC
Duration: up to 90 minutes
Scope: Rolling restarts and kernel patching on a subset of eu-west1 serving nodes.
Impact: Some requests routed to eu-west1 may experience brief 5xx errors or elevated latency. Most customers: no action required.
```

Priya Patel: for customer email, add: "We will pause the maintenance and roll back changes if elevated errors persist beyond 10 minutes during canary." explicit rollback language reduces interim support load.

Jesse B.: adding that. new customer blurb: 
```
Hello,
We will perform maintenance in our EU region on 2026-05-10 between 02:304:00 UTC to apply stability fixes. A small fraction of traffic to eu-west1 may see transient 5xx or higher latency. If we see sustained errors during canary, we will halt and revert changes and notify you. No action required; contact support if you need continuous routing to another region.
```

Maya Singh: internal preflight checklist I'm going to drop here for the handoff: 
- Preflight: confirm dashboard panels for 5xx, p50/p95 latency, host OOM, container restarts.
- Canary: route 3% traffic to patched nodes for 12 minutes. success criteria: 5xx < 0.3% and p95 latency within 25% baseline.
- Abort: any 5xx > 0.8% sustained for 10m or host daemon restarts detected.
- Post: promote incrementally only if canary passes two consecutive windows.

infra-sre: adding a helper script to runbook: `./tools/fallback-route --to eu-central --force --reason "maintenance"` and a dry-run variant. PR incoming to docs.

Diego R.: please include console banner copy so product can approve: 
"Planned maintenance in EU (eu-west1) on 2026-05-10 02:30-04:00 UTC. Some requests may get brief errors or higher latency. See status.redwood.ai for updates."

Alice Chen: good. timeline: 
- Now: finalize statuspage + console banner + paid-customer email drafts (Jesse/Priya/Alice)
- T-6h: internal heads-up to enterprise customers with opt-in for direct pager notifications
- T-30m: oncall preflight + confirm runbook scripts and canary job
- During: Maya (oncall) leads, infra-sre handles host fixes, Priya owns paid customer comms
- Post: completion notice and short incident summary if we abort or roll back

Jesse B.: support FAQ draft uploaded to support docs: how to check region, how to temporarily switch endpoints, and our rollback policy. link: internal://support/docs/eu-maint-faq (internal).

incident-bot: Update: INC-2026-417 acknowledged by Maya Singh. Automated mitigation: hosts eu-west1-pool-9 removed from rotation. 5xx is trending down to 0.4%.

Maya Singh: preflight pass=not yet. dashboards pinned to channel. canary scripts: `scripts/canary-eu.sh --percent 3 --duration 12m` ready to run.

Priya Patel: I'll draft the paid-customer email and queue at T-6h. also preparing a short canned response for support agents to paste into replies.

Jesse B.: statuspage entry ready for posting once Alice approves. console banner ready. who wants to be designated customer POC during the window for enterprise outreach?

Alice Chen: Priya take POC for enterprise. I'll own the public status updates and the console message.

Diego R.: quick note: include a short SRE runbook step to force routes to eu-central if needed: `kubectl apply -f route-fallback-eucentral.yaml` and have runbook owner test it now. saves time later.

infra-sre: will test and post results. adding non-interactive fallback flag and writing a small recovery playbook.

Maya Singh: finalizing abort criteria in runbook: 
- Abort immediately and rollback if canary 5xx > 0.8% for 10 continuous minutes.
- If host kernel panics or node reboots >3 within 15m, stop and revert.
- Notify paid customers within 5m of abort decision.

Jesse B.: posting status page now. preview link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-05-10-eu-maint-preview (internal).

Priya Patel: queued paid-customer email and support replies. also tagging accounts that requested advance notice in last quarter.

Alice Chen: thanks all. react :thumbsup: when you
confirm your task. we'll reconvene in this thread 1h before window for final checks.

support-bot: Reminder scheduled: send customer follow-up + support ticket summary 1h after maintenance completion.

Jesse B.: completion template I'll use (edit as-needed):
```
Maintenance completed: 2026-05-10 03:47 UTC
Summary: Rolling updates applied to eu-west1 serving nodes. Canary observed brief transient 5xx during validation; changes were either rolled forward after passing final checks or rolled back if abort criteria met. If you experienced ongoing errors, please reply and we'll investigate.
```

Maya Singh: note: I'll trigger incident-bot final status post when the maintenance job finishes and update this thread with exact timestamps.

Alice Chen: closing note: keep pages quiet and safe ops. thanks team."
